question: Why does opening more checkouts help only if any cashier can serve any customer?
options: Because more checkouts always cost less than a faster cashier
Because a customer who must return to one particular cashier cannot be sent to a free checkout
Because customers prefer the same cashier every time
explanation: This is stateless scaling. If a server must keep the user's data in its own memory, the balancer cannot send that user anywhere else, so extra servers do not help them. Cost is a separate question.
